title: Mouse Without Borders 0.1 Test 2
summary: This is an unsigned test build of the standalone green Mouse Without Borders fork. Download `MouseWithoutBorders.exe` from Assets and use this same release on every computer.
changes: Fixes the first launch that could create a prefs file but leave MWB invisible until it was run again.
Uses the embedded green application icon for the notification-area tray icon.
Replaces the malformed two-size icon with a validated multi-resolution Windows icon.
Makes the Settings Help link open this standalone project's repository.
Updates the visible product version to 0.1.0 and refreshes the repository documentation.
testing: Start in a new empty folder with no `MouseWithoutBorders.prefs.json` file and confirm the first-launch choice appears immediately.
Choose Run portable here and confirm the Settings window and green tray icon appear during that same run.
Open Help and confirm it opens the standalone project page.
Use this same Test 2 EXE on both computers for mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file-transfer, reconnect, and sleep/wake checks.
